title: zapbot, the ZAP helper bot account
description: When the zapbot GitHub account and its X account appear, and what zapbot commits in the four repositories, from 2015 to the release automation commits of today.

chapters.title: The account, June 2015
chapters.text: The GitHub API gives the zapbot account (display name "zapbot - ZAP helper bot") a creation time of 2015-06-04 09:30 UTC. The comment that the logo notes in the zaproxy repository link to for the original lightning bolt design (issue 74, comment 108865883) was created by the zapbot account at 12:13 UTC the same day.

chapters.title: The GitHub and X accounts
chapters.text: The zapbot GitHub profile gives its location as "In the 'cloud'", its website as http://zapbot.github.io/zap-mgmt-scripts/index.html and its X username as zaproxybot. Its public repositories include forks of zaproxy and zap-core-help created on 2015-11-10 and of zap-extensions created on 2015-11-11, and a zap-mgmt-scripts repository created on 2015-11-10. The X profile at x.com/zaproxybot says "Joined December 2016", about 18 months after the GitHub account was created.

chapters.title: First commits, November 2015
chapters.text: The earliest commits in the dataset authored as zapbot are dated 2015-11-10 and are both titled "Latest files from Crowdin", one in zaproxy and one in zap-extensions. The same day, three merge commits in zap-extensions bring in pull requests #73, #74, and #75 from branches of the zapbot repositories (master, beta, and alpha); they are recorded under a different author name for the bot.

chapters.title: Releases and translations, 2021
chapters.text: "Release add-on(s)" and "Prepare next dev iteration(s)" commits by zapbot start in zap-extensions on 2021-06-17 and in zap-core-help on 2021-10-06. "Update localized resources" starts on 2021-08-12 in zaproxy, zap-core-help, and zap-hud, and on 2021-08-13 in zap-extensions. "Webdriver Update" starts in zap-extensions on 2022-04-28.

chapters.title: The author name changes
chapters.text: A few commits record the bot under a longer author name. The first is dated 2018-01-10 ("Latest files from Crowdin (#1237)" in zap-extensions). A later, shorter variant first appears on 2024-06-19 ("Webdriver Update (#5515)") and matches the account's display name on GitHub today. Most zapbot commits use the plain author name "zapbot".
